claim: Wellbeing Nutrition Natural Vitamin D3 achieved A+ rating on Unbox Health (LAS 10/10, NTS 10/10) with lab-measured Vitamin D of 13.31mcg vs claimed 15mcg (within reasonable accuracy).
stance_target: benchmark for good Vitamin D3 label accuracy in India
scope_conditions: Unbox Health NABL-accredited lab testing, India
quoted_support: Wellbeing Nutrition Vitamin D3 received a higher rating (A+) vs HealthKart Vitamin D3 (C) in Unbox Health's independent lab tests, based on higher Label Accuracy Score. Label Accuracy: Wellbeing Nutrition Vitamin D3 (10 out of 10) received a higher score than HealthKart Vitamin D3 (5.6 out of 10).

claim: Unbox Health rates Vitamin D3 supplements on a D to A+ scale based on Label Accuracy Score (measure of nutrient label match to lab-found values) and Non-Toxicity Score (heavy metals/contaminants vs FSSAI safety limits).
quoted_support: Unbox Health rates products from D to A+ after testing every product at multiple accredited labs for their label accuracy, toxicity and nutritional profiles.
